items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Interviewer identifies 'Puppet Blue' as the band playing, Interviewee responds 'About the little band' without claiming personal interaction or specific role with Puppet Blue.

ctx.x: He played with the Claiborne William band many times up at the Pelican. Over, four years ago. Right up in 19, in the 20's. The Claiborne William band. Ernest played trombone, trumpet and cytopone. I'm gonna take quite a left. He's a good man. Yeah. Yeah.
I'm gonna put a record on now, huh? Yeah. Why don't you tell me what you think of this band? Yeah. That's Puppet Blue. That's right. Puppet Blue band, yeah. He's a part of the band, huh? Huh? Yeah.
